claims.claim: pm_taxCO2eqSum is declared in 46_carbonpriceRegi; the default realization none declares it at none/declarations.gms:11, and netZero also declares it at :23 but is off by default
core/datainput.gms:13 and core/preloop.gms:44 initialise it to 0
core/presolve.gms:10 computes it as pm_taxCO2eq + pm_taxCO2eqRegi + pm_taxCO2eqSCC on every iteration
The 2030 cap at core/presolve.gms:15 is active only when cm_CO2PriceLimit is not off, which is the default
core/postsolve.gms:51-56 derives it from the q_co2eq marginal only when cm_emiscen is 6 (line 56 only when it is 1), so it is inactive by default
47_regipol/regiCarbonPrice writes it at presolve:24 and postsolve:151/962/976/986/1001, gated by cm_emiMktTarget, cm_regiExoPrice and cm_regiExoPrice_fromFile, all off by default
21_tax/on reads it in q21_taxrevGHG, CO2Sector, CO2luc, Import and CDR, and in its pre/postsolve revenue parameters and p21_taxCO2eqSum_NetNegEmi
core reads it at presolve.gms:256: p_priceCO2 = pm_taxCO2eqSum * 1000
47_regipol copies it into p47_taxCO2eq_AggEmi/_AggFE/_SectorAggFE at postsolve:448-468, only when cm_emiMktTarget is not off
46_carbonpriceRegi/netZero postsolve.gms:68 reads it for a rescale without assigning it; netZero is off by default

grade.went_well: The answer keeps three things apart: where the parameter is declared, where it is assigned, and where it is read. It leads with the default configuration and checks the switch gating for every override; I confirmed each default in main.gms. The line citations match a grep of the codebase exactly. It is also honest about its scope: it says it did not trace the three components. Its list of readers is more complete than the key, adding netZero and the core p_priceCO2 assignment.
grade.answer_key_issues: The key is correct but less detailed than the code allows. It doesn't mention two other kinds of writer. First, core/postsolve.gms:51-56 overrides the value when cm_emiscen is 6 or 1. Second, 47_regipol/regiCarbonPrice assigns it in several places, all off by default. The key also lists 47_regipol only as a reader, but the module both reads and writes the parameter. Finally, the key leaves out the netZero declaration and its read at netZero/postsolve.gms:68.
grade.summary: I found no errors in this answer. 46_carbonpriceRegi (realization none) declares pm_taxCO2eqSum, and core/presolve.gms:10 computes it as the sum of three components. The readers are core, 21_tax, 33_carbonRemoval and 47_regipol. The answer also correctly lists the non-default overrides in core/postsolve.gms and in regiCarbonPrice, each with its switch gating.
